requests.name: Scavenger
requests.note: Scavenger (common 100): a deny gives +25 mana, +40 health.
requests.request: Denying a creep restores 25 mana and 40 health. No gold.

requests.name: Heavy Hands
requests.note: Heavy Hands (common 100): attacks +40% damage, 25% longer between them.
requests.request: Attacks deal +40% damage but are 25% slower.

requests.name: Homeguard
requests.note: Homeguard (common 100): inside your tower's 650 range, +25% attack speed and +5 health regen.
requests.request: While near your own tower: +25% attack speed and +5 health regen.

requests.name: Rally Cry
requests.note: Rally Cry (common 100): leashed creeps +30% damage, take 30% less.
requests.request: Leashed creeps deal +30% damage and take 30% less damage.

requests.name: Adrenaline
requests.note: Adrenaline (common 100): each last hit takes 1 s off R's cooldown.
requests.request: Each last hit takes 1 s off your ultimate's cooldown.

requests.name: Keen Eye
requests.note: Keen Eye (common 100): attack shots fly 50% faster.
requests.request: Your attack shots fly 50% faster.

requests.name: Clean Finish
requests.note: Clean Finish (common 100): attacks +15% vs creeps below half health.
requests.request: Your attacks deal +15% damage to creeps below half health.

requests.name: Kindling
requests.note: Kindling (rare 250): burns +2 s (IGNITE, RAGE); dying while burning ignites the nearest unit of its side within 150 (a spark line shows it).
requests.request: Your burns last 2 s longer. When a burning enemy dies, one enemy within 150 catches fire.

requests.name: Cold Read
requests.note: Cold Read (rare 250): enemies with any move or attack slow take +12% from you (any slow counts, not only yours).
requests.request: Enemies you slow take +12% damage from you.

requests.name: Serrated
requests.note: Serrated (rare 250): attacks on heroes apply a 2 s bleed (+10% to your attacks; with TRAP the stronger bleed wins).
requests.request: Your attacks make heroes bleed for 2 s: your attacks on them deal +10%.

requests.name: Spite
requests.note: Spite (rare 250): shields on you or given by you (BRACE, Second Wind) reflect 30% of what they soak at the hitting creep or hero (not towers; reflections don't reflect).
requests.request: Shields you get or give send 30% of the damage they absorb back at the attacker.

requests.name: Second Wind
requests.note: Second Wind (rare 250): dropping below 30% health gives a 150 shield for 3 s, once per 40 s.
requests.request: When you drop below 30% health, gain a 150 shield for 3 s (once every 40 s).

requests.name: Siege Breaker
requests.note: Siege Breaker (rare 250): attacks +40% vs towers (tower shields already need one of your creeps in range).
requests.request: Your attacks deal +40% damage to towers while one of your creeps is in the tower's range.

requests.name: Glass Cannon
requests.note: Glass Cannon (rare 250): +35% ability damage, -20% max health.
requests.request: +35% ability damage, -20% max health.

requests.name: Overclock
requests.note: Overclock (rare 250): -30% cooldowns, abilities cost 40% more mana (the ability bar shows the real cost).
requests.request: -30% cooldowns, but abilities cost 40% more mana.

requests.name: Spellblade
requests.note: Spellblade (rare 250): after any cast the next attack is charged: +40 damage, 20% move slow for 1 s (ringed shot).
requests.request: After casting an ability, your next attack deals +40 damage and slows 20% for 1 s.

requests.name: Aftershock
requests.note: Aftershock (epic 600): a stun by you (RAGE) or your Tank Minion sets off a 60-damage shockwave, radius 200, at most once a second.
requests.request: Whenever you stun an enemy, a shockwave hits everything within 200 for 60.

requests.name: Reserve
requests.note: Reserve (epic 600): Q gets +1 charge (2 total). No BECKY exception: each SHADE keeps its windup and warning line — watch it.
requests.request: Your Q holds 2 charges. (Watch BECKY: two SHADEs may need an exception.)

requests.name: Afterimage
requests.note: Afterimage (epic 600): a dash / blink leaves an unhurtable decoy for 2 s; enemy creeps, towers and the bot lose track of you and go for it.
requests.request: Dashing or blinking leaves a decoy where you started; for 2 s enemies (the bot, creeps, towers) attack it instead of you.

requests.name: Hunter's Mark
requests.note: Hunter's Mark (epic 600): ability hits mark heroes 4 s (pink ticks); your next attack on a marked hero deals +15% of its missing health and spends the mark.
requests.request: Your abilities mark heroes for 4 s; your next attack on a marked hero deals +15% of their missing health.

requests.name: Recruit
requests.note: Recruit (epic 600): a creep you deny rises (pale) at half health and fights for 6 s, worth no gold. Denies are your own creeps, so it comes back on your side.
requests.request: Creeps you deny get back up and fight for your side for 6 s.

requests.name: Vanguard
requests.note: Vanguard (wave 400, max 1): melee creeps gain a 60 shield for 8 s on entering the enemy tower's range.
requests.request: Your melee creeps gain a 60 shield when they reach the enemy tower's range. Max 1.

requests.name: Sappers
requests.note: Sappers (wave 450, max 1): one ranged creep a wave (lit fuse) blasts the enemy tower for 150 if it dies in tower range.
requests.request: One ranged creep in each of your waves explodes for 150 on the enemy tower when it dies in the tower's range. Max 1.

requests.name: Pathfinders
requests.note: Pathfinders (wave 300, max 1): your creeps walk 20% faster.
requests.request: Your waves walk 20% faster. Max 1.

requests.name: Standard Bearer
requests.note: Standard Bearer (wave 350, max 1): the middle front melee creep carries a flag; your creeps within 300 attack 25% faster while it lives.
requests.request: A banner creep leads your waves: your creeps within 300 attack 25% faster while it lives. Max 1.

requests.note: Bounty Hunter (rare 250): no gold now; your attacks on creeps below 25% health land instantly (shots already home, so 'can't miss' = instant). Name kept.
requests.request: No more gold. Make it a gentle last-hit helper instead: your attacks on creeps below 25% health fly twice as fast and can't miss.
